svg.aria-label: The first run: Claude asks four questions, then work starts. 1, your GitHub account, so commits sign with its private noreply address; 2, a hub folder; 3, a projects folder; 4, whether to turn on the optional ChatGPT lane. Then your idea becomes the first ledger item and the first phase starts

text.font-family: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
